notes.title: v1.1.0 Release Notes
notes.notes:
v1.1.0 Release Notes
- Fixed a bug where the whole game freezes after some events.
- Fixed a bug where all pauses in the game took longer than expected on some computers.
- Supported Steam Cloud.
- Added an exit button on the title screen.
- Some other subtle bug fixes.
